progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ds4 and dwells most on F# in Pahlavi. The line peaks at A#4 (470.5 Hz) at 0:13.0. It closes on Ek4, not the tonic (E4 → D#4 → D#4 → D#4 → E4 → Ek4).
